notes: `עַד אֲשֶׁר` is fused to the single *until* rather than leaving the relative unrepresented; the bare `אֲשֶׁר` of the first clause keeps its supplied *in which* as one relative rendering, on rule 22's `אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ` → *wherein* reasoning.

*were* of the numeral predicate joins the numeral phrase under rule 20; `אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה` has its rectum rendered anarthrously, so the fronted *the* is the article's under rule 29, while `מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה` is the arthrous case and nothing is fronted.
